integrity: A mathematical proof, finite boundary certificate, and reproducible Python checks are supplied. Independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns ordinary closed-neighborhood domatic partitions of two-token graphs of simple cycles only. The construction does not classify all such partitions or extend to other token counts, arbitrary host graphs, or domatic games. Historical priority remains provisional; finite computational tests are subordinate to the unrestricted mathematical proof.
title: Sharp three-domatic threshold for two-token cycle graphs
